evals.prompt: Give me a full remediation playbook for CVE-2021-44228 in our maven log4j-core 2.14.1 dep.
evals.expected_output: A structured V2 remediation plan with registry fix (2.17.1), source commits, workarounds with effectiveness scores, CWE-502 guidance, and per-package-manager verification commands.
expectations: Auto-populates `--ecosystem maven --package-name log4j-core --current-version 2.14.1 --package-manager maven` from repo state
Calls `vulnetix vdb remediation plan CVE-2021-44228 -V v2 --include-guidance --include-verification-steps -o json` piped through `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/_lib/jq/remediation.jq`
Renders Registry Fixes table with columns Ecosystem | Package | Current | Fix Version | Verified | Confidence | Registry
Surfaces CrowdSec threat-activity section (totalSightings, uniqueIPs, lastSeen, MITRE techniques) when present
Presents CWE-502 / CWE-917 guidance and Verification Steps per package manager (mvn dependency:tree, etc.)
Updates `.vulnetix/memory.yaml` with `versions.fixed_in`, severity, safe_harbour, and a `history` event `remediation-plan` — does NOT change status/decision unless the user makes one

evals.prompt: We have a Containerfile with `FROM node:18-alpine` and CVE-2024-XXXXX affects an npm dep. Build the full remediation plan including distribution patches.
evals.expected_output: Remediation plan with container-aware context (--container-image node:18-alpine, --os alpine) returning both registry fix and distribution patches table.
expectations: Detects Containerfile/Dockerfile via Glob and extracts the FROM image as `--container-image node:18-alpine`
Passes `--container-image` and an `--os` flag derived from the base image to the remediation plan call
Renders a Distribution Patches table (Distro | Patch ID | Affected Packages | Priority) when patches are present
Falls back to V1 `vulnetix vdb fixes` only if V2 returns an error, noting that workarounds/CWE/verification enrichment is unavailable
If `gh auth status` succeeds, queries Dependabot for an existing PR on this CVE and surfaces it as `Dependabot PR #N proposes this upgrade`
Constructs a `--purl pkg:npm/<name>@<version>` when ecosystem + name + version are all known

evals.prompt: No patch exists yet for this CVE we just got hit by — what are my options?
evals.expected_output: A workaround-led remediation plan with effectiveness scoring, an automatic fetch of Snort traffic-filter rules, and clear messaging that this is an interim mitigation.
expectations: When no registry fix is returned, automatically runs `vulnetix vdb traffic-filters "$CVE" -o json` and presents each rule's rawText with signatureSeverity and confidence
Renders Workarounds section with effectiveness score (out of 100), applicable versions, requires-restart flag, and verification steps
Explicitly states 'No patch available yet — workaround is interim mitigation' or equivalent wording
Appends a `remediation-plan` event to `.vulnetix/memory.yaml` history summarising workaround + traffic-filter availability
Uses the `agent_prompt` field internally to inform analysis but does NOT print it raw to the user
